aws.review.cloudformation.output_secret_.title: CloudFormation outputs have no observed high-confidence secret indicators
aws.review.cloudformation.output_secret_.description: Observes private-key markers, paired AWS access credentials and literal password assignments using a bounded partial configuration detector. Values are inspected only before shared caching, then discarded; complete matching provenance is required. A negative indicator does not prove that configuration contains no secrets.
aws.review.cloudformation.output_secret_.review_notes: Corrected partial replacement for cloudformation_stack_output_no_secrets: pinned SQL matches pass/secret/token/key substrings in both names and values and an unanchored character-mix expression, causing benign keyword false positives. The CloudFormation SQL starts from jsonb_array_elements(outputs), so null/empty output stacks emit no row despite its later null-output branch. Native negative results mean only that selected high-confidence indicators were absent from a successfully inspected response, not absence of all secrets. Malformed/unreadable evidence is not converted into empty/clean; safe markers retain no literals, value hashes, snippets, output keys or reconstructible secret tokens. Unsettled stack operations are UNKNOWN rather than certifying outputs not yet available. CloudFormation preserves only validated numeric CDKToolkit BootstrapVersion for existing operational checks; no other output values are retained.

rows.title: Route53 record does not point to a dangling AWS resource
rows.evidence_or_counterexample: Counterexample: a DNS A record intentionally targets another account’s active AWS IP, or CNAME targets a legitimate external account’s existing S3 website bucket. rows.missing_or_unassessed: Useful unmatched-target candidate inventory remains distinct: complete cross-region EIP/ENI/bucket coverage and current IP-range data are needed; external nonexistence/reclaimability requires separately authorized evidence.

rows.title: S3 bucket is not a known shadow resource owned by another account

rows.missing_or_unassessed: Need authoritative ownership plus actual service dependency/authorization evidence; denied/incomplete own-bucket inventory is not foreign ownership proof.
